ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels covering approximately 80% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones are localized at the outer tips of both lobes; significant white mottling and focal spots transition into the low-intensity dark central field along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 70 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips of both lobes; the jaggedness of the distal margins suggests cumulative historical edge wear.
